reason: Report composes evidence from domain-authoritative services. It owns no book of record and has no authoritative report-wide comparand owner, common comparison cut, tolerance or retained assembled-report check from which to form a reconciliation verdict. Unknown is therefore the deliberate contract posture, including for a ready report whose individual sources are reconciled.
retention_meaning: Capture retains the report-wide unknown status and reason. Retained read, replay and rerender preserve that evidence; canonical revision identity proves retained identity, not a common source cut or reconciliation verdict.
